source_analysis.skill: Recognize or expose a same-angle sine-cosine product, apply sin(2x)=2sin(x)cos(x), evaluate a familiar doubled angle exactly, and retain coefficient/sign.
reasoning_steps: For products factor coefficient/2; for squares expand and use sin²+cos²=1; for reciprocal quotients replace 1/sec by cos or 1/csc by sin.
Double the angle in its displayed unit and retrieve exact sine with quadrant sign.
Simplify the coefficient or 1±sin(2x) and select or enter the exact value.
invariants: Equal arguments in the sine and cosine pair.
Doubled angles have routine exact sine values; reciprocal denominators must be defined.
Every exposed rewrite and final simplification appears in worked steps.
No calculator, new identities, or solving for unknown angles.
permitted_variations: Angles, degrees/radians, quadrant and sign may vary independently of response position.
Multipliers may be positive/negative integers or small radicals with manageable simplification.
Square plus/minus and reciprocal sec/csc roles can change; neither qualifying form nor correct option position is essential.
